parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistAPIVersionTests.swift`. The structural similarity (Jaccard 0.78) between `PlaylistAPIVersionTests.defaultsToV1WhenNoOverrideOrFlag` and `PlaylistAPIVersionTests.nonStringFeatureFlagFallsBackToDefault` is characteristic of test methods that exercise distinct but related edge cases of the same API surface — each test encodes a separate, intentional scenario (no override/flag vs. non-string flag fallback) and must remain independently named and independently runnable. Merging or extracting them would obscure test intent and violate the restraint rule that any cluster containing a test-marked record defaults to no-action.
